items.title: Moving at the speed of pharma digitalisation: driving ROI from AI and digital tools
items.summary: Discover how GSK, Boehringer Ingelheim, Takeda and more than 100 pharma leaders scale digital projects at AUTOMA+ 2026 in Switzerland.

items.title: Sandoz targets industry patent void with $322m Henlius deal
items.summary: Sandoz and Henlius will collaborate on up to 10 biosimilars amid opportunity to capitalise on global biosimilar loss-of-exclusivities.

items.title: Lantheus Holdings’ Alzheimer’s radiodiagnostic secures FDA approval
items.summary: Lantheus's radiodiagnostic is designed to identify cognitively impaired patients who have tau neurofibrillary tangle (NFT) pathology.

items.title: EMA validates Pfizer and Valneva’s Lyme disease vaccine
items.summary: The EMA has validated the MAA from Pfizer and Valneva for their Lyme disease vaccine candidate, PF-07307405.

items.title: FDA grants fast track status to Phanes’ spevatamig for advanced BTC
items.summary: Phanes Therapeutics has received fast track designation from the US FDA for spevatamig to treat patients with advanced and metastatic BTC.
